{"text": "The function `create_model` dynamically generates a new Pydantic model class at runtime.", "type": "intent"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` accepts parameters that define the model's name, configuration, base classes, docstring, validators, and fields.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` constructs a namespace with annotations, module information, and field definitions.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` uses Python's `types.prepare_class` to create the new class.", "type": "structural"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` raises a `PydanticUserError` if both `__base__` and `__config__` are provided.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` warns if `__slots__` is used.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` treats the use of `__slots__` as deprecated in this context.", "type": "behavioural"},
{"text": "The function `create_model` returns the newly created model class.", "type": "dataflow"},
{"text": "The model class returned by `create_model` can be instantiated like any other Pydantic model.", "type": "intent"}
]
